name: Mam cong
summary: Mắm còng is a crab paste the Tiền Giang provincial portal places at Tân Phú Đông. The same portal’s 25 Dec 2018 introduction says mắm còng cù lao Tân Thới. The two place names stay. The index extract calls peeled-crab mắm the best and does not print the method.
origin: Tân Phú Đông on the 5 Jan 2019 food index. Cù lao Tân Thới on the portal introduction of 25 Dec 2018. Neither line is a Mỹ Tho stall.
howToEat: The food-index extract says crab is fried or cooked in soup, and that peeled-crab mắm is the best, with a simple method the extract does not print.
A price was not printed. The price is Check on arrival. An hour was not printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Tân Phú Đông, or cù lao Tân Thới, depending on which portal line you use. A street was not printed. The address is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Mam cong — Tan Phu Dong or Tan Thoi
seoDescription: The Tiền Giang provincial portal places mắm còng at Tân Phú Đông and, in its 25 Dec 2018 introduction, at cù lao Tân Thới. The method was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.
